{"findings":[{"file":"src/lookup.ts","line":4,"severity":"high","category":"security","rule":"SQL injection or command injection via string concatenation or template literals with user input","message":"The caller-supplied `user` value is joined straight into a shell command run by execSync, so input like `x; rm -rf ~` or `$(...)` runs arbitrary commands. Use execFileSync('grep', ['-F', '--', user, '/etc/passwd']) so no shell is involved. Better still, read /etc/passwd with fs and match the first ':'-separated field exactly. Also validate `user` against a strict username pattern. Note that execSync throws when grep finds no match (exit code 1), so handle that case on purpose instead of letting it escape as an error."}],"score":0.4,"summary":"Block: src/lookup.ts adds a command injection hard failure. src/math.ts and the config, ignore and rules files add no rule violations."}
